changelog:
- Initial release of indeed-full: a comprehensive Indeed job postings toolkit via RolesAPI.com.
- Enables searching Indeed listings by keyword and location, retrieving full job details, salary info, descriptions, company data, and benefits across 60+ countries.
- Includes scripts for fetching data by job key or URL, checking salary and benefits, and monitoring API credit usage.
- Requires a ROLESAPI_KEY for authentication; free plan includes 100 credits at signup.
- Designed to only activate on explicit job data requests to conserve API credits.
summary: Complete Indeed job postings toolkit via RolesAPI.com. Search Indeed job postings by keyword and location, fetch full role details, look up salary for a job...
